鐘.english: a (large) bell (CL:架[jia4]); clock (CL:座[zuo4]); amount of time; o'clock (CL:點|点[dian3],分[fen1],秒[miao3]) (as in 三點鐘|三点钟[san1dian3zhong1] "three o'clock" or "three hours" or 五分鐘|五分钟[wu3fen1zhong1] "five minutes" etc)

廠.english: factory; yard; depot; workhouse; works; (industrial) plant

鄉.english: country or countryside; native place; home village or town; township (PRC administrative unit)

神.english: God; god; deity; supernatural; magical; mysterious; spirit; mind; energy; lively; expressive; look; expression; (coll.) awesome; amazing

機.english: surname Ji; (bound form) machine; mechanism; (bound form) aircraft; (bound form) an opportunity; (bound form) crucial point; pivot; (bound form) quick-witted; flexible; (bound form) organic

獎.english: prize; award; bonus; reward; (bound form) to encourage; to commend; to praise; to award; to give as a reward

文.english: surname Wen; language; culture; writing; formal; literary; gentle; (old) classifier for coins; Kangxi radical 67

書.english: abbr. for 書經|书经[Shu1 jing1]; book; letter; document; CL:本[ben3],冊|册[ce4],部[bu4]; to write

能.english: surname Neng; can; to be able to; might possibly; ability; (physics) energy

兩.english: two; both; some; a few; tael, unit of weight equal to 50 grams (modern) or 1⁄16 of a catty 斤[jin1] (old)

用.english: to use; to make use of; to employ; (coverb) with; using; to need; to have to (usu. used in the negative or in questions); usefulness; utility; (bound form) expense; outlay; (courteous) to eat; to drink; (literary) hence; therefore

離.english: surname Li; to leave; to part from; to be away from; (in giving distances) from; without (sth); independent of; one of the Eight Trigrams 八卦[ba1 gua4], symbolizing fire; ☲

爭.english: to strive for; to vie for; to argue or debate; deficient or lacking (dialect); how or what (literary)

住.english: to live; to dwell; to stay; to reside; to stop; (suffix indicating firmness, steadiness, or coming to a halt)

宅.english: residence; (coll.) to stay in at home; to hang around at home

從小.english: from childhood; from a young age

一種.english: one kind of; one type of

出聲.english: to make a sound; to speak; to cry out

情緒.english: mood; state of mind; moodiness; CL:種|种[zhong3]

一塊.english: a piece; a chunk; (fig.) (coll.) (typically preceded by a specifier such as 這|这[zhe4]) aspect; area; dimension (Example: 情感這一塊|情感这一块[qing2gan3 zhe4 yi1kuai4] "the emotional aspect (of it)"); (coll.) one yuan; a dollar; together; in the same place; in company

那麼.english: like that; in that way; or so; so; so very much; about; in that case

只有.english: only have ...; there is only ...; (used in combination with 才[cai2]) it is only if one ... (that one can ...) (Example: 只有通過治療才能痊愈|只有通过治疗才能痊愈[zhi3 you3 tong1 guo4 zhi4 liao2 cai2 neng2 quan2 yu4] "the only way to cure it is with therapy"); it is only ... (who ...) (Example: 只有男性才有此需要[zhi3 you3 nan2 xing4 cai2 you3 ci3 xu1 yao4] "only men would have such a requirement"); (used to indicate that one has no alternative) one can only (do a certain thing) (Example: 只有屈服[zhi3 you3 qu1 fu2] "the only thing you can do is give in")

做派.english: way of doing sth; behavior; to act in an affected manner; mannerism; gestures in opera

可以.english: can; may; possible; able to; not bad; pretty good

一個.english: a; an; one; the whole (afternoon, summer vacation etc)

還有.english: there still remain(s); there is (or are) still; in addition

就是.english: exactly; precisely; only; simply; just; (used correlatively with 也[ye3]) even; even if

十幾.english: more than ten; a dozen or more

出來.english: to come out; to appear; to arise; (after a verb, indicates coming out, completion of an action, or ability to discern or detect)

牽亡歌.english: folk song for guiding spirits of the dead

衝上.english: to rush to; to shoot up to
